shots.caption: Modern. Familiar. *Ready.*
shots.subtitle: A complete AAC board from day one, in the colors SLPs already teach.

shots.caption: Every word has *a place to live*.
shots.subtitle: Folders a child can see, with the way home marked on every page.

shots.caption: Whole phrases for *gestalt learners*.
shots.subtitle: An SLP's starter phrases, ready in Small words.

shots.caption: Tap the words. *Hear the sentence.*
shots.subtitle: An advanced mode that turns a child's words into a full sentence.

shots.caption: Five art styles. *Every word drawn.*
shots.subtitle: Classic in three skin tones, Playful 3D, and High Contrast.

shots.caption: See which words *actually get reached*.
shots.subtitle: Coverage by page and by kind of word, worked out on the device.

shots.caption: AI when you want it. *Off until you say so.*
shots.subtitle: Uses your own OpenAI key. Nothing is sent until you turn it on.
